findings.finding: The reviewed numerical diffusion flux uses epsilon/pi; HF attribute is named Nu. Both interpretations require explicit publication binding.
The reviewed generator computes one more time coordinate than stored solution frames, consistent with the observed metadata pattern; this alone does not prove historical generation identity.
Longitudinal viscous momentum flux includes face density times zeta+4*eta/3, not a density-independent constant dynamic viscosity.
Reviewed configuration uses gamma=5/3 and pressure floor 1e-4; archived data lack full per-trajectory configuration provenance.
Reviewed example configurations specify 1000 samples while HF files contain 10000: these configs cannot be declared exact generation manifests.
The trans closure fills ghost layers by copying nearby interior primitive states; its exact stencil and boundary fluxes matter for a continuous boundary interpretation.
